Done. The merge succeeded on the first execution.

- **Solution:** `out/T4/solution.py`, a plain script on safetensors and torch. It checks identical name sets across the three checkpoints, bit-exact equality of all 180 non-MLP tensors, then computes each task vector against the unmodified base in float32 and casts back to float16.
- **Checks enforced:** name-set match, shared-tensor equality, exactly 64 merged, exactly 244 written, plus a re-read of the output file. Any failure exits with an error.
- **Output:** `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 244 tensors, 64 merged.
- **Report:** `out/T4/REPORT.md` records one execution, no failures, and the tools used (safetensors 0.5.3, torch 2.14.0).
